title.narrative: Programa de Fomento al Turismo-Ciudad Colonial de Santo Domingo
Tourism Development Program - Colonial City of Santo Domingo

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es dinamizar la competitividad del sectorturstico dominicano, a travs de una diversificacin de la oferta actual quepermita satisfacer segmentos de demanda de alto gasto, generar mayoresbeneficios para la poblacin local y disminuir la presin sobre la costa. Elobjetivo especfico es incrementar el ingreso y el empleo generado por el turismoen la Ciudad Colonial de Santo Domingo, a travs del desarrollo de productos tursticos de alto potencial competitivo.

The general objective of the program is to boost competitiveness in the Dominican tourism sector through diversification of the current tourism offerings in order to cater to high-spending demand segments, generate greater benefits for the local population, and reduce pressure on the coast. The specific objective is to increase the revenues and jobs generated by tourism in the Colonial City of Santo Domingo, through the development of tourism products that have high competitive potential.
